name: smwmusic-the-12th-vanilla-level-design-contest-city-map
title: The 12th Vanilla Level Design Contest - City Map
description:
The song that plays in VLDC12's city map. Started with the idea of city pop, and then threw in some @9 and abrupt detuning to really give that vibe of drunkenly stumbling across downtown on a Saturday night.

Features a slightly different tempo change from the one featured in the current as-of-now version of the hack (1.03) because I made changes to the .txt that I forgot to send to Stivi.
